question: Are 'evidence not in window' rejections a product defect or the model quoting outside the window?
answer: Product defect. Replaying every rejected quote through the shipped evidenceSources (src/extraction/evidence.ts, copy in evidence_replay.ts with PLAYER_MARK inlined) against the window messages parsed from the audit prompt: run1 14 of 15 and run2 23 of 28 match a message IN the window once markdown '*' is removed, 0 match as-is. normalizeEvidenceText (src/extraction/evidence.ts:17-23) strips quotes and . ! ? , ; : ( ) [ ] { } dashes but not '*' (nor '_'), and ST narration is wrapped in *italics*, so the message's first/last word is '*the' / 'area*' and a whole-word span never matches a quote that starts or ends at an emphasis boundary. Not window bounds, not greeting exclusion (message 0 is in the window and in the prompt), not the D1 label fix (label-prefixed quotes like '[29] DM Narrator: ...' also resolve once stars are stripped). Remaining genuine out-of-window quotes: 'Decide whether to take Luke along before departing for the Sun Ruins.' (checkpoint objective text, not transcript) (2x) and three stitched multi-message quotes.
J7.4_run1: riddle_answer WAS accepted (audit 20:22:23 cue:cp-4a->cp-4a1, window 24-31, v=moon, evidence the player line) and cp-4a -> cp-4a1 fired at the next boundary 20:38:32. J7.4 failed on its schedulerIdle wait (600 s) with queueDepth 2 inFlight: from 20:18 to 20:37 the journal shows 5 health events 'memory model did not answer within ~63 s' and backend-metrics shows 3-4 requests processing / 1 deferred with near-zero token generation (prefill-bound, 3 lanes sharing LLM_PARALLEL 4). Not the scene judge (judge off in J7, no judge events), not A8. Timing/backend contention, not the evidence rule.
J7.5_run1: Same drain-wait timeout (queueDepth 3, heavyQueueDepth 1) under the same contention; chamber_entered was also rejected by the '*' defect at 21:02:32 (window 32-39) before it was accepted at 21:04:28.
J7.5_run2: Product defect directly: chamber_entered=true rejected 'evidence not in window' at 23:37:00 (cue cp-4a1->cp-5, window 32-39, quote in msg 38) and 23:37:19 (cadence, window 39-41, quote in msg 39); both resolve once '*' is stripped. Both checkpoint waits (2 x 300 s) timed out at cp-4a1; the gate was satisfied only by reconcile:chamber_entered at 23:51:24, after the check had failed. Backend was not saturated (requests_processing mostly 1).
secondary: parse.ts:133-136: a bool/int written quoted (chamber_entered value="true", guardian_respect value="1") parses as a JSON string and is rejected 'invalid value'; the D3 tolerance covers enums only (run1 20:22:23).
